name: trap-operator-test-ec322bfc54/trap-operator-v.bal
spec_references: Statements / Foreach: Currently only supports range, list, map, string and XML subtypes, and [iterable objects](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_5.8.2)
Subset restrictions / Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: `error:message`
reason: The case exercises supported trap expressions around function-value calls and an enclosing call whose argument panics, asserting error capture and the supported error.message() result. Its range foreach asserts that trapping a panic permits all ten iterations. Anonymous functions, calls, panic, error construction, type tests, range iteration, module variables and compound addition are covered; no applicable invocation or langlib restriction excludes the behavior.
test_design_notes: No @args, @panic or @output markers occur; main invokes both assertion-bearing helpers.
The unused io:println function reference is instrumentation. No obvious mixed-scope or marker issue.
